new_senses.rationale: Both Turoyo clauses predicate usefulness with l-beneficiaries. Propose one provisional new entry from attested mawṯərone only. III and Part act. are working lexicographic affiliations; -one may instead belong to a learned lexical adjective. No finite paradigm is inferred.

added_examples.turoyo: Yaʕni kətli niše, tre w at trani ste kəmarno, əəə mede mawṯərone lu ʕamayḏan gədhowən.
added_examples.translation: That is, I have two aims, and both too, I say, will be something beneficial to our people.
added_examples.rationale: First evidence for the provisional lexical entry: two aims predicted to be beneficial to the people; future gədhowən belongs to hwy, not a finite yṯr form.
added_examples.translation_status: project machine translation; no edition translation

added_examples.turoyo: Isḥoq Baroše: D bayn u ʕamo ənnu d muḏʕi, mən kit, mən layt, mən mawṯərone la ʕlaymayḏan w la ʕlaymoṯayḏan.
added_examples.translation: Ishoq Baroshe: Among the people, to make known what there is, what there is not, what is useful for our young men and our young women.
added_examples.rationale: Second independent clause with young men/women as l-beneficiaries; no additional sense.
